reddit.title: Introducing Detailed Material Management in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to announce a significant update to how building materials are displayed in Provincia! No longer will you see a single cost chip hiding the complexity of resource requirements. Each build now features a detailed Materials sheet that clearly shows what you have versus what you need, with shortages highlighted for easy management. This change enhances your building experience, allowing you to plan more effectively. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Enhanced Materials Management in Provincia
steam.body: We're thrilled to introduce a new feature that changes how you interact with building materials in Provincia. Instead of a single cost chip, each paid tile now displays a detailed Materials sheet, showing you exactly what resources you have and what you need. This update makes it easier to manage your colony's construction projects efficiently. Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
